body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose a 2-unit area within 4 units. Prepare a hidden hazard there until the start of your next turn; enemies treat the area as difficult terrain.

surges.html: After rolling, you may change this Action to another eligible target within 2 units of the original target.
Draw, conceal, place, or interact with one small carried or unattended item as part of this Action.

rider.title: TRAP CONTINGENCY
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Contingency. Trigger: An enemy enters the prepared space. Effect: It burns 1 die on its next Action.
rider.meta: EXPIRES: START OF YOUR NEXT TURN
